name: ui-comparison
description: Six React UI libraries rendering the same reference screen, side by side

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n mui,mantine,chakra,antd,shadcn,daisy -c blue,cyan,magenta,red,white,yellow "npm --prefix ./mui run dev" "npm --prefix ./mantine run dev" "npm --prefix ./chakra run dev" "npm --prefix ./antd run dev" "npm --prefix ./shadcn run dev" "npm --prefix ./daisyui run dev"
scripts.install:all: concurrently -n mui,mantine,chakra,antd,shadcn,daisy "npm --prefix ./mui install" "npm --prefix ./mantine install" "npm --prefix ./chakra install" "npm --prefix ./antd install" "npm --prefix ./shadcn install" "npm --prefix ./daisyui install"
scripts.build:all: concurrently -n mui,mantine,chakra,antd,shadcn,daisy "npm --prefix ./mui run build" "npm --prefix ./mantine run build" "npm --prefix ./chakra run build" "npm --prefix ./antd run build" "npm --prefix ./shadcn run build" "npm --prefix ./daisyui run build"
scripts.typecheck:all: concurrently -n mui,mantine,chakra,antd,shadcn,daisy "npm --prefix ./mui run typecheck" "npm --prefix ./mantine run typecheck" "npm --prefix ./chakra run typecheck" "npm --prefix ./antd run typecheck" "npm --prefix ./shadcn run typecheck" "npm --prefix ./daisyui run typecheck"
